goal: After the currently active J-Quants Production Materialization campaign completes cleanly, deepen freshness and historical coverage of the existing decision-useful Research Studio domains without broadening the data taxonomy. First, make the production Research Snapshot and PIT company/fundamental research layer incrementally refreshable so its as-of date advances from the current 2026-06-30 baseline toward the latest source-available date while preserving available_from_date semantics, actual/forecast separation, correction provenance, deterministic rebuilds, idempotency, resumability, and fail-closed missing/stale states. Current Market and earnings surfaces must remain independently fresh and must never be rolled back to an older snapshot. Second, extend approved daily price/volume history in measured stages: establish verified 3Y coverage first, then 5Y, then 10Y only where the approved source actually supplies sufficient history. Never synthesize or approximate unavailable long history, and keep each capability disabled until coverage/audit thresholds are genuinely met. Reuse stored data before making external calls; any missing-history acquisition must be bounded, incremental, resumable, quota-aware, and must preserve existing J-Quants/EDINET request reserves and provider limits. Extend quarterly earnings and forecast-revision history only where source evidence is available, retaining historical forecast snapshots rather than overwriting them. Add production health and Data Status evidence for snapshot freshness, historical min/max dates, per-period coverage, missing/stale counts, and capability readiness. If shareholder-benefit production materialization/source-gate work is still incomplete after the active campaign, finish only the remaining source-evidence and production-read-model gap needed for reliable annual benefit value, investable capital, benefit yield, and total yield; otherwise do not redo it. Do not add news sentiment, broad IR text analysis, activist/shareholder monitoring, large technical-indicator sets, or unrelated categories. Do not raise paid/provider quotas or bypass rate limits. Preserve atomic publication, PIT correctness, security boundaries, CI, and runtime verification. Conserve Vercel deployments: validate through repository CI and production-independent checks, batch changes, and deploy only when the existing deployment quota allows and a materially complete change set is ready. Success means the Research Snapshot is no longer a static 2026-06-30 island, 3Y/5Y/10Y capabilities become truthfully enabled only as real coverage permits, core historical gaps are measurably reduced, Data Status exposes freshness/coverage clearly, and the live Workspace can use the deeper data without look-ahead leakage or invented values.
